Account and payments

  • activate bonuses and view wagering progress;

Elarabet Casino offers a 24/7 live chat service, as well as a contact form in your personal account. The live chat is suitable for questions about deposits, bonuses, KYC or withdrawal status, whilst the form is handy when you need to attach a document or describe a situation in detail.   • over 7,000 games from 100+ providers, including 350+ live tables;

  • support for cards, mobile wallets, bank transfers and cryptocurrencies;

  • PWA for iOS and Android, 24/7 live chat and manageable responsible gaming limits.

For new players, Elarabet Casino provides a clear step-by-step process: registration, verification of contact details, a deposit of €20 or more, and the choice of a bonus or a game. A dedicated section on Elarabet keeps active offers, VIP progress and available personalised rewards all in one place. mainEntity.name: Do I need to activate my Elarabet VIP level separately after reaching a new status?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your VIP progress on Elarabet is updated automatically after completed rounds, provided your bets meet the programme’s conditions. Users can view their accumulated points and current level in their profile, and the reward for the new status is credited automatically without the need for a separate request.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the Elarabet bonus if I don’t manage to meet the wagering requirements within 7 days?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bonus funds have a limited validity period of 7 days from the date they are credited. If the wagering requirements are not met within this period, the remaining bonus may be forfeited in accordance with the terms of the specific promotion. Before activation, it is advisable to check the bet limit (€5 during wagering), the 40x wagering requirement and other restrictions.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the currency of my Elarabet account after making my first deposit?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, once you’ve made your first successful transaction, you cannot change your account’s primary currency. Therefore, when registering, you should immediately select the currency in which you intend to manage your balance – EUR, GBP or one of the supported cryptocurrencies.

mainEntity.name: Why might Elarabet request KYC specifically when withdrawing funds, if the deposit has already gone through?

acceptedAnswer.text: KYC may be required not only when creating an account, but also before the first withdrawal or after changing the payment method. Verification is required to confirm your identity, protect your payment profile and comply with AML requirements. You can track the status of your document verification directly in your account.

mainEntity.name: Do Elarabet’s VIP progress and bonuses work the same way on a mobile and a computer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the PWA version uses the same account, balance and bonus system as the desktop version. Users can view their VIP progress, activate offers, manage payments, set limits and play slots or live casino games from their mobile device without having to create a separate profile.
